blocks.text: Synthesis mein target molecule ko saada aur bazaar mein aasani se milne wale (commercially available) compounds se shuru kar ke banaya jata hai. Aakhri target molecule tak pohanchne mein kai steps ya tabdeeliyan (transformations) ho sakti hain. Maslan primary aliphatic amine sirf aik step mein ban sakti hai: haloalkane ko ammonia ke saath react karaein.

blocks.title: Reaction ki conditions
blocks.text: Kitab ammonia wale teer (arrow) par CCl₄ likhti hai. Chapter 21 mein yeh substitution reaction ethanol mein ghuli hui ammonia ke saath, pressure par garam kar ke kiya jata hai.

Haloalkane aasani se nahi milta; yeh alcohol se banaya jata hai, aur alcohol starting material ke tor par zyada aasani se milta hai. Is liye alkyl amine ki synthesis do steps mein mukammal ki ja sakti hai: pehle SOCl₂ se alcohol ko chloroalkane banayein, phir NH₃ se amine.

blocks.prompt: Ethanol se ethanamine do steps mein kaise banayenge?
blocks.explanation: Step 1: CH₃CH₂OH + SOCl₂ → CH₃CH₂Cl + SO₂ + HCl. Step 2: CH₃CH₂Cl + NH₃ → CH₃CH₂NH₂ + HCl (ammonia zyada miqdar mein, ethanol mein, garmi aur pressure par).

items: Synthesis aasani se milne wale compounds se target molecule ki taraf barhti hai.
